openweb-org-openweb-sites-airbnb.description: Travel marketplace — accommodation search, listing details, reviews, availability, and host profiles via Node fetch + direct GraphQL API.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-amazon.description: E-commerce marketplace — search products, view details, read reviews, browse deals, manage cart.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-angellist.description: AngelList Venture (`venture.angellist.com`) — investor-side dashboard for syndicates, deals, and LP messaging. Logged-in only. Read-only coverage.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-apple-podcasts.description: Apple Podcasts content platform — search, browse, and get details for podcasts and episodes via the AMP API.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-arxiv.description: Open-access preprint server for scientific papers (arxiv.org). Public Atom API at export.arxiv.org for search and metadata retrieval, plus HTML abstract pages.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-bbc-news.description: Global news — the BBC's public news service covering world, UK, business, technology, sport, and more.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-bestbuy.description: E-commerce — electronics retailer. Three read APIs (search, details, pricing) plus a write pair (addToCart / removeFromCart) keyed by server-generated `lineId`.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-bilibili.description: Chinese video sharing and social platform (similar to YouTube). Archetype: Chinese Web / Video + Social.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-bloomberg.description: Financial news and market data. Top news headlines, breaking news, market ticker, search, company profiles, stock charts, and market overview via Bloomberg's Next.js SSR data.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-bluesky.description: Bluesky AT Protocol social network — decentralized microblogging. Public read API at `public.api.bsky.app`, write ops via user's PDS (Personal Data Server).

openweb-org-openweb-sites-booking.description: Travel platform — hotel search, property details, reviews, room pricing, and flight search via Apollo SSR cache + LD+JSON + GraphQL page.evaluate + DOM.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-boss.description: China's leading direct-recruiting job platform (Chinese web / job board archetype). Job seekers chat directly with bosses/HR. Search jobs, view details with salary info, explore company profiles, and get salary statistics.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-chatgpt.description: ChatGPT backend API — OpenAI's conversational AI interface. Content platform archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-cnn.description: Major US cable news network. CNN.com provides breaking news, analysis, and video content across politics, world, business, health, entertainment, and more.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-coingecko.description: Cryptocurrency data aggregator. Public REST API for searching coins, checking prices, market data, and trending tokens.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-coinmarketcap.description: Cryptocurrency market data and rankings. Real-time prices, market caps, volumes, and trending tokens from CoinMarketCap's internal data API.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-costco.description: E-commerce warehouse club. Product search, detail, reviews, warehouse locator, delivery options, cart management, and product comparison.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-craigslist.description: Classic US classifieds platform — search listings across cities and categories, view listing details, browse category structure. Pure server-rendered HTML, no JS framework.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-docker-hub.description: Container image registry. Public REST API for searching and browsing Docker images, tags, and metadata.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-doordash.description: Food delivery marketplace — search restaurants, browse menus, view order history, manage cart.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-douban.description: Chinese media review/rating platform (movies, books, music). Social/media archetype — 14 operations across movies, books, music, and discovery via mobile JSON API.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-ebay.description: eBay — world's largest auction and marketplace platform. E-commerce archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-espn.description: Sports news, scores, and data. Public REST APIs — no auth required.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-etsy.description: Handmade and vintage marketplace — search listings, view details, shop profiles, and reviews.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-expedia.description: Travel booking platform. Hotels and flights search via GraphQL APQ (Automatic Persisted Queries).

openweb-org-openweb-sites-fidelity.description: Financial services platform. Stock quotes, market indices, mutual fund research, company profiles, and news from Fidelity Investments.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-github.description: GitHub REST + GraphQL API — code hosting platform (developer tools archetype).

openweb-org-openweb-sites-gitlab.description: GitLab REST API v4 — code hosting and DevOps platform (developer tools archetype).

openweb-org-openweb-sites-glassdoor.description: Glassdoor is a company review and job research platform (archetype: job boards). All data accessed via browser-based adapter with Cloudflare challenge bypass; no official API.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-goodreads.description: World's largest book community (Amazon-owned). Search books, get book details with ratings and reviews, and explore author profiles.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-goodrx.description: Drug price comparison platform. Compare prescription drug prices across pharmacies and find nearby pharmacies.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-google-flights.description: Flight search and pricing — adapter-based DOM extraction from rendered Google Flights pages.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-google-maps.description: Google Maps — location search, place details, directions, and geocoding. Adapter-based extraction from internal APIs and SPA DOM.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-google-scholar.description: Academic paper search engine (Google). Search papers, explore citation graphs, and view researcher profiles with h-index and publication history.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-google-search.description: Search engine (archetype: search). Google.com — autocomplete suggestions, organic web/image/news/video/shopping results, local business pack, knowledge panel, People Also Ask, and related searches via page DOM extraction.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-grubhub.description: Grubhub is a food delivery platform (archetype: Food Delivery). Search restaurants, browse menus with prices, and check delivery time/fee estimates.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-hackernews.description: Tech news aggregator by Y Combinator. Reads via Algolia Search API and Firebase API (node-direct). Writes via browser page context.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-homedepot.description: Home improvement retailer (archetype: e-commerce). homedepot.com — product search, details, reviews, pricing, and store availability via GraphQL federation gateway interception.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-huggingface.description: AI model and dataset hub. Public REST API for searching and browsing ML models, datasets, and Spaces (demo apps).

openweb-org-openweb-sites-imdb.description: IMDB is the world's most popular movie and TV database. Data fetched via GraphQL API (`api.graphql.imdb.com`) — no auth required. Ratings histogram from SSR fallback.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-indeed.description: Job search platform. Search jobs, view postings, salary data, company profiles, and reviews.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-instacart.description: Grocery delivery marketplace. Archetype: Food Delivery.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-instagram.description: Social media platform (Meta). Photo/video sharing, stories, reels.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-jd.description: Chinese e-commerce (京东). Product search, detail, reviews, and pricing via DOM extraction.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-kayak.description: Travel meta-search engine — flights, hotels across 100+ providers.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-leetcode.description: Coding challenge and competitive programming platform. Search problems, get daily challenges, browse contests, view user profiles and contest rankings via LeetCode's GraphQL API.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-linkedin.description: Professional networking platform — social media archetype with Voyager REST/GraphQL API.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-medium.description: Blogging and publishing platform. Content platform archetype. Search articles, browse topic feeds, discover curated lists, explore writers, clap articles, follow writers, and save bookmarks via Medium's GraphQL API.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-notion.description: Productivity and collaboration workspace. Enterprise archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-npm.description: JavaScript package registry at registry.npmjs.org. Public REST API for package search, metadata, versions, and download statistics.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-npr.description: Major U.S. public media news outlet. Public Algolia search index provides full article content including text, author, date, topics, and audio availability.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-opentable.description: Restaurant reservation platform — search restaurants, view details and reviews, check reservation availability. Commerce archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-openweb.description: Typed JSON access to 90+ real websites — Google, Amazon, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Instagram, Bloomberg, Zillow, and more — across search, shopping, travel, finance, social, news, and dev tools. Use to read, search, post, comment, message, or otherwise interact with these sites (prices, products, articles, stock quotes, flights, posts, comments, DMs, etc.). Run `openweb sites` for the full list.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-pinterest.description: Visual discovery and bookmarking platform. Social media archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-producthunt.description: Product discovery platform — daily curated tech products, tools, and startups with community voting.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-pypi.description: Python Package Index — the official repository for Python packages. Public JSON API, no auth required.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-quora.description: Q&A platform — users ask questions, write answers, follow topics and users.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-reddit.description: Social media platform — link aggregation, discussion, communities (subreddits). Social Media archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-redfin.description: Real estate marketplace — search homes for sale, view property details, and check housing market data.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-reuters.description: International news agency. News archetype — search articles, browse topic feeds, read full articles, and get top/breaking news via Arc Publishing (PageBuilder Fusion) API.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-robinhood.description: Stock trading platform — market data archetype. Stock quotes, crypto prices, fundamentals, analyst ratings, earnings, historicals, market movers, and curated collections via Robinhood's internal APIs.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-rotten-tomatoe.description: Movie review aggregator. Search movies, get details with Tomatometer and audience scores, cast, and synopsis.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-seeking-alpha.description: Investment research and analysis platform. Stock ratings, earnings data, analyst articles, and community-driven stock analysis.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-soundcloud.description: Music streaming platform popular with independent artists. Public REST API at api-v2.soundcloud.com for searching tracks, viewing artist profiles, and browsing playlists.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-spotify.description: Music streaming platform. Content platform archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-stackoverflow.description: Developer Q&A platform. Public REST API (Stack Exchange API v2.3) for searching questions, reading answers, browsing user profiles, and exploring tags.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-starbucks.description: Coffee chain (archetype: food/retail). starbucks.com — store finder, store details, and menu browsing via BFF API proxy interception.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-steam.description: Gaming marketplace. Game search, details, pricing, user reviews, news, player counts, and achievements via Steam's public APIs.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-substack.description: Newsletter and long-form content platform. Content platform archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-target.description: Target.com — major US e-commerce retailer. Product search, detail, store availability, and cart management via internal Redsky aggregation and cart APIs.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-techcrunch.description: Leading tech news outlet covering startups, venture capital, AI, and technology. Built on WordPress with a public WP REST API at techcrunch.com/wp-json/wp/v2/.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-telegram.description: Telegram — messaging platform. L3 adapter reads via webpack `getGlobal()`, writes via `callApi()` to GramJS Web Worker. Zero DOM manipulation.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-guardian.description: Major UK/international news outlet. Open public REST API at content.guardianapis.com for searching articles, fetching full content, and browsing section feeds.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-tiktok.description: Short-video social platform. Content platform archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-trello.description: Kanban board task management. Productivity/collaboration archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-ctrip.description: China's largest travel platform (Ctrip International). Flights, trains, attractions, and destination guides via Trip.com's internal POST-only REST APIs. Travel archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-tripadvisor.description: Travel review and booking platform. Archetype: Travel. Adapter-only site — all data extracted from LD+JSON structured data and DOM on SSR pages.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-twitch.description: Live streaming platform. All public data served through a GraphQL API at `gql.twitch.tv/gql` using persisted queries (sha256 hashes) or raw GQL queries. No auth needed for public reads.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-uber.description: Ride-hailing platform. Location search, fare estimates, ride history via GraphQL on m.uber.com and riders.uber.com. Cookie_session auth shared across uber.com subdomains.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-ubereats.description: Food delivery platform. Restaurant search, menu browsing, cart operations, order history. REST + adapter on ubereats.com, cookie_session auth.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-walmart.description: E-commerce. Walmart.com — product search, detail pages, pricing, and cart operations. Read ops use Next.js SSR extraction; write ops use an adapter with persisted GraphQL mutations via browser context.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-weibo.description: Chinese microblogging platform (social media). China's Twitter/X equivalent with trending topics, user timelines, post detail/comments, and write operations (like, repost, follow, bookmark).

openweb-org-openweb-sites-whatsapp.description: Messaging platform — L3 adapter accessing Meta's internal module system via `require('WAWeb*')`.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-wikipedia.description: Wikipedia — free encyclopedia. Reference archetype. Three APIs: MediaWiki Action API for search/metadata, REST v1 for summaries/feeds, Core REST for article source and history.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-x.description: Social media and microblogging platform. Archetype: Social Media. GraphQL API with persisted query hashes, L3 adapter for dynamic hash resolution and request signing. REST v1.1/v2 endpoints for social graph and moderation actions.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-xiaohongshu.description: Chinese social media / lifestyle platform — Instagram + Pinterest hybrid. Archetype: Social Media.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-xueqiu.description: Chinese finance and social investing platform. Stock quotes, order book, industry comparisons, market events, and social discussion feed.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-yahoo-finance.description: Financial data portal. Stock quotes, charts, financials, market screeners, analyst ratings, and company insights via Yahoo Finance internal APIs.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-yelp.description: Local business discovery platform — search businesses, autocomplete suggestions, read reviews. Commerce archetype.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-youtube.description: Video content platform. InnerTube JSON API on `www.youtube.com`.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-youtube-music.description: YouTube Music (music.youtube.com) is Google's music streaming platform. Content Platform archetype — all public data served through the InnerTube API.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-zhihu.description: Chinese Q&A knowledge-sharing platform (Quora archetype). Users ask questions, write answers, publish articles, and follow topics.

openweb-org-openweb-sites-zillow.description: Real estate marketplace. Search properties, get full property details, Zestimates, and neighborhood data.
